segments.normalizedSource: ```swift let node = SKNode() var nodePosition = CGPoint() func update(_ currentTime: TimeInterval, for scene: SKScene) { nodePosition = node.position } func didEvaluateActions(for scene: SKScene) { let distance = hypot(node.position.x - nodePosition.x, node.position.y - nodePosition.y) if distance > 0 { // code to react to position change } } ```
